episode_definition: Contiguous union sample points exceeding limit; neighboring brackets retained, no exclusion/alignment or accuracy pass based on recovery. Subthreshold holes split episodes.
limitations: Interpolation at scheduled decisions is supplemental; the original all-time physical gate and all failed switching edges remain unchanged.
Observed edge displacement is descriptive, not proof that all differences are harmless timing shifts.
Both model recovery warnings and incomplete strict run prevent qualification.
